text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit heavy trucks in the public lane adjacent to No. 2 Braemore Gardens. This is in order to reduce potential damage to the abutting property. Implementing a heavy truck prohibition will have a negligible impact on traffic operations.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited heavy trucks at all times in the public lane adjacent to 2 Braemore Gardens.
